==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
From {{der|en|fr|option}}, from {{der|en|la|optiō|t=choice; option; act of choosing}}, from {{m|la|optō|t=to choose, select}}. Equivalent to {{af|en|opt|-ion}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɒpʃən/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɑpʃən/|a=GenAm}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-option.ogg|a=US}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# One of a set of [[choice]]s that can be made. {{defdate|from 19th c.}}
# The [[freedom]] or [[right]] to choose.
# {{senseid|en|Q187860}}{{lb|en|finance|legal}} A [[contract]] giving the holder the right to buy or sell an [[asset]] at a set [[strike]] price; can apply to financial [[market]] [[transactions]], or to ordinary transactions for [[tangible]] assets such as a residence or automobile. {{defdate|from mid-18th c.}}
# {{lb|en|law|uncountable}} The acquiring or retention of a [[nationality]] through personal choice as a [[right]], bypassing selective legal mechanisms for [[naturalization]], especially in cases where a territory is transferred or passed on from one state to another.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1928|title=Appeal to the Noble English Nation by the Committee of the Defenders of the Rights of Palestinian Arab Emigrants to the Palestinian Citizenship|page=10|text=At that time every emigrant who was made aware of such a notification submitted his application for '''option''' to the British Consuls within the period prescribed.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2012|author=Oliver W. Vonk|title=Dual Nationality in the European Union: A Study on Changing Norms{{nb...}}|isbn=9789004227200|page=243, note 154|pageurl=https://books.google.co.uk/books?id=GTYzAQAAQBAJ&pg=PA243|text=This group constitutes around 9 percent of the total number of acquisitions of Dutch nationality through '''option'''.}}

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|alternative}}
* {{l|en|choice}}
* {{l|en|possibility}}
* See also [[Thesaurus:option]]

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# To purchase an option on something. {{defdate|from 20th c.}}
#: {{ux|en|The new novel was '''optioned''' by the film studio, but they'll probably never decide to make a movie from it.}}
# {{lb|en|computing|dated}} To [[configure]], by setting an option.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1991|author=Martin D. Seyer|title=RS-232 made easy
|passage=The device that is to echo the characters should be '''optioned''' for echoplexing.}}
